title: It's not glass like described
text: It's not glass like described. This is not like described. It is not glass, it is plastic. Not the same and not worth the same price. I can get a much nicer frame with real GLASS from Target. It'd be nice if whomever writes the details gives the actual details rather than a lie so customers know what they are actually getting.
